name: Yokawa Hatsumi
source:
The daughter from a shipping company.

She has a masculine personality, probably because she was raised by young delinquents who worked for the company since she was a child.

After school, she helps her family with their work, so she has a strong physique. She has a fatherly nature. She does not care too much about small things.

She is the only one who seems to have been a resident of a hot spring resort for generations.
